description: OLED and AMOLED displays produce light at the pixel level, while LCD screens rely on a separate backlight. This difference affects how each screen handles blacks, contrast and power use. AMOLED is also a type of OLED rather than a completely separate display technology. OLED-based panels are more common on mid-range and premium phones, while LCD remains popular in affordable models. Burn-in is another consideration with OLED and AMOLED displays. However, display quality depends on more than the panel type, so brightness, refresh rate, resolution and HDR support also matter.
title: AMOLED vs OLED vs LCD Phone Displays Explained: Which Display Is Right for You?

description: Samsung has fixed almost everything with last year's Fold 7. The display crease on the main display is nearly gone, the screen handles sunlight better now, the battery is bigger on paper, and the performance is legitimately flagship-tier. The camera's better too, mostly thanks to a much-improved ultrawide lens. What didn't get fixed is the telephoto camera, and the design, which still looks like last year's phone. Add in another price hike, and "Ultra" starts to feel more like a marketing gimmick.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Review: The Best Z Fold Yet

description: Skullycandy’s Method 360 ANC is a mid-range take on the more expensive Bose QuietComfort Ultra TWS, aiming to deliver better sound and ANC capabilities at an affordable price point. While it is a great collaboration, we aren’t very happy with the resulting product. This mainly because of how they sound and that quirky charging case.
title: Skullcandy Method 360 ANC Review: Bose-Tuned Sound at Half the Price?

description: Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL), once one of India’s premier telecom service providers, has been slowly ramping up its offerings for consumers. In recent months, the state-owned operator has begun rolling out Wi-Fi calling services, along with the CNAP (Caller Name Presentation) feature for its users. If you’re an existing BSNL customer, you can easily find out details related to your current balance, remaining data allowance, and how long your pack will remain valid.
title: How to Check BSNL Data Balance Using Various Methods: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: The Xiaomi TV FX Mini LED 65 combines a 65-inch 4K QD Mini LED panel with Full Array Local Dimming, HDR10+ and Fire TV. Its 60Hz native panel and lack of Dolby Vision are notable compromises, but the overall package makes it a compelling option at Rs. 64,999.
title: Xiaomi TV FX Mini LED 65 Review: A Mini LED TV That Gets the Basics Right

description: Android phone battery life can be extended by simply tweaking a few settings and following the best charging practices. You should enable adaptive brightness from your phone’s control centre or Settings menu, allowing your Android handset’s ambient light sensor to adjust based on the environment. This allows your device to only utilise the power that is needed. If you still feel that your Android phone’s screen brightness is too high, you can manually adjust it to an optimal level to increase its battery life.
title: How to Improve Battery Life of an Android Phone: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: OLED, QLED and Mini LED TVs use different technologies to produce and control light, which affects everything from black levels and brightness to viewing angles and long-term use. OLED pixels produce their own light, while QLED and Mini LED TVs rely on LCD panels and backlights. QLED adds quantum dots, while Mini LED uses smaller backlight LEDs for more precise control. OLED can be ideal for darker rooms, while QLED and Mini LED can suit brighter spaces. Price and burn-in are also worth considering.
title: OLED vs QLED vs Mini LED TVs: Which One Is Right for You?

description: Android phone users can choose to check how much storage an app is taking on their handset easily. This helps you identify large apps that you might not be using regularly, but are still occupying space on your phone’s internal storage. There is only limited storage available on Android phones. If your handset does not support an external microSD card, you do not even have an option to upgrade it. Hence, it is important that you know which app is taking how much storage space, allowing you to prioritise your usage.
title: How to Find Which Apps Are Taking Up Storage on Android Phone: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Samsung's Galaxy S26 FE is expected to arrive as the latest Fan Edition smartphone in the Galaxy S26 family. The phone could feature a 6.7-inch 120Hz display, Exynos 2500 chipset and a 4,900mAh battery with 45W charging. Leaks also point to three rear cameras, including a telephoto sensor, and three colour options. Samsung is expected to unveil the device on August 27, while its software package could include seven Android OS upgrades and security updates.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Roundup: Launch Date, Price, Specifications, Features
